dialogs.browser_compat_voice: Voice search is not supported or is blocked by this browser.

dialogs.debug_desc: Run browser checks and test compatibility surfaces.
dialogs.debug_feature_dialog: Required for settings, add-site, and upload dialogs.
dialogs.debug_feature_indexeddb: Required for larger custom wallpapers and MP4 wallpapers.
dialogs.debug_feature_random_uuid: Required for reliable shortcut ID generation.
dialogs.debug_feature_structured_clone: Required for safe state copying and loading.
dialogs.debug_feature_color_mix: Required for exact theme color rendering.
dialogs.debug_feature_local_storage: Required for bookmarks, settings, language cache, and notices.
dialogs.debug_feature_extension_storage: Required for extension-side wallpaper and pending-link sync.

library.title: Library
library.desc: Keep extra actions here instead of on the main page.

view_mode.title: View mode
view_mode.desc: Switch between grid and list layouts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Tune the overall look of the page.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: Choose the base mode and visual style.

search_suggestions_all_engines.label: Suggestion mode
search_suggestions_all_engines.note: Choose whether suggestions use the current engine or the checked engine list below.

search_suggestion_engine_limit.label: Suggestion engines
search_suggestion_engine_limit.note: Limits how many engines run at the same time when multi-suggestions are enabled.

search_suggestion_engine_list.label: Suggestion engine list
search_suggestion_engine_list.note: Choose which engines can run at the same time when multi-suggestions are enabled.

surface.title: Surface
surface.desc: Control text size, roundness, transparency, and glass effect.

layout.title: Shortcut layout
layout.desc: Choose shortcut display mode, density, and card size.

panels.title: Panels
panels.desc: Control how strong the center UI panels appear.

wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.desc: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4.

upload_background.label: Upload custom wallpaper file
upload_background.note: Images and GIFs are supported normally. MP4 is supported up to 24 MB; very high resolutions may still fail to save.

reset.title: Reset
reset.desc: Restore the current appearance or wallpaper defaults.

debug.title: Debug
debug.desc: Tools for testing and resetting local browser data.

debug_tools.title: Debug tools
debug_tools.desc: Open browser checks, test notices, and local storage tools.

local_storage.title: Local storage
local_storage.desc: Clear page data stored in localStorage.

search.title: Search
search.desc: Choose the search provider and suggestion behavior.

search_provider.title: Provider
search_provider.desc: Pick the default engine used by the main search box.

reset_appearance.title: Reset appearance
reset_appearance.desc: Restore colors and appearance values without changing bookmarks or wallpaper.

page_elements.title: Page elements
page_elements.desc: Show, hide, and style the main page modules.

clock.title: Clock
clock.desc: Control the clock module and its display style.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.desc: Choose which main modules appear on the page.

reset_background.title: Reset background
reset_background.desc: Return to the theme background without changing other appearance settings.

updates.title: Updates
updates.desc: Check GitHub Releases and let the browser install published extension updates.
updates.note: Store and managed installations update automatically. Unpacked extensions must be updated manually because browsers do not allow extensions to replace their own files.

status.no_release: No published GitHub Release was found.
status.unsupported: Automatic update checks are unavailable in this installation.
